title: Aircall vs Calilio for HubSpot Teams — Jon Martin
seoTitle: Aircall vs Calilio for Small HubSpot Teams
description: Aircall or Calilio for a small team on HubSpot: entry prices, seat minimums, what lands in HubSpot, and which plan has a power dialer.
h1: Aircall vs Calilio for a small team on HubSpot
dek: Both are cloud phone systems that log calls into HubSpot. The price floor is very different.
Prices and integration details come from each vendor's own pages, checked on the date shown.

blocks.html: This is for a small team that runs HubSpot and needs business phone numbers with calls logged to the CRM. Maybe it's two reps and a founder, maybe it's a five-person inbound desk.
The rule I use for any phone system on HubSpot: pick it by where the call record ends up. If calls don't land on the HubSpot record, your activity reports are missing half the work.

Aircall is the safer pick if you want call activity on deals and tickets, not only contacts, and you have at least three people on the phones. Calilio is the cheaper pick for a very small team. Its HubSpot connection is newer; the HubSpot integration went live in September 2026.
Both give you a way out if it doesn't fit. Calilio offers a 14-day money-back guarantee. Aircall's pricing page offers free access to try it.

Aircall Essentials is $30 per license per month, billed annually. Professional is $50 per license per month. There's a minimum of 3 licenses on Essentials and Professional, so the smallest Essentials account runs about $90 a month. Aircall's page shows 25% off for paying annually. Power Dialer comes with Professional.

Calilio Standard is $12 per user per month billed annually, or $15 billed monthly. Premium is $28 per user per month billed annually, or $35 billed monthly. Three Standard users on annual billing run about $36 a month. Plan limits: Standard caps out at 10 users; Premium has no user limit. Power Dialer is on Premium only.
Aircall logs calls and SMS to HubSpot Contacts, Companies, Deals, and Tickets, with recordings, comments, outcomes, and transcription. Insight Cards show HubSpot history before a rep answers.

With Calilio, every call, text, and voicemail lands on the right HubSpot contact timeline, with recordings, AI summaries, and transcripts. The integration page lists 16 events synced to HubSpot, and the pricing table shows the HubSpot integration is on both Standard and Premium.

The difference that matters for most HubSpot teams: Aircall names deals and tickets as places call activity lands. Calilio's HubSpot page describes the contact timeline and doesn't mention deals or tickets. If your reports are built on deals, ask Calilio about that before you switch.
One to three callers, mostly contact-level follow-up, tight budget: Calilio. Three or more callers, call activity reported on deals or tickets, or a service team creating tickets from calls: Aircall.
Need a power dialer? On Aircall that means Professional; on Calilio it means Premium. Price the plan that has it, not the entry plan.
